questions.stem: Mia missed my call. She will c________ after her lesson.
questions.explanation: With the pronoun me, use call me back.
questions.parentExplanation: 代词宾语me置于call和back之间，此处表示回电话。

translation.stem: 米娅没接到我的电话，她会在下课后给我回电。

questions.stem: The door is open. Please c________ and sit down.
questions.explanation: Come in is used to invite someone to enter.
questions.parentExplanation: come in可作请进的祈使句；in为副词，不加to。

translation.stem: 门开着，请进来坐下。

questions.stem: Mia w________ after lunch every Sunday.
questions.explanation: Mia takes washes or does; keep the and plural dishes.
questions.parentExplanation: Mia为第三人称单数，用washes the dishes或does the dishes。

translation.stem: 米娅每周日午饭后清洗餐具。

questions.stem: Ben's family sometimes e________ when everyone is busy.
questions.hint: has a meal away from home
questions.explanation: Family can be one unit (eats out) or its members in British English (eat out); both are accepted.
questions.parentExplanation: family作整体时用eats out；英式英语强调家庭成员时eat out也自然，两者接收。

translation.stem: 大家都忙时，本一家有时出去吃饭。

questions.stem: We make a cake and sing together to c________ Dad's birthday.
questions.hint: Use a verb meaning mark a happy event with special activities.
questions.explanation: The cake and song are special activities to celebrate the birthday.
questions.parentExplanation: 用蛋糕和歌声庆贺生日，用celebrate；to后接原形。

translation.stem: 我们做蛋糕、一起唱歌，庆祝爸爸的生日。

questions.stem: Do you m________ if I open the window, or would the cold air bother you?
questions.hint: Use the verb meaning object to or feel bothered by something.
questions.grammar: Do you mind if + 句子
questions.explanation: Asking whether someone objects to an action uses Do you mind if.
questions.parentExplanation: 询问对方是否介意某事，用Do you mind if；do后用原形。

translation.stem: 你介意我打开窗户吗，还是说冷空气会让你不舒服？

questions.stem: What does “make friends with” mean in this passage?
questions.explanation: Here “make friends with” means “begin a friendly relationship with someone”. The sentence says: I make friends with a boy called Amir during this activity.
questions.parentExplanation: “make friends with”在此处对应“（和某人）交朋友”中的本句义项；句意为：在活动中，我和一个叫阿米尔的男孩交上了朋友。

translation.stem: 短文中的“make friends with”是什么意思？

options.label: A
options.text: a story about a distant planet

options.label: B
options.text: the ordinary things someone does each day

options.label: C
options.text: only the final day of a holiday

options.label: D
options.text: one unusual event in the future

questions.stem: What does “daily life” mean in this passage?
questions.explanation: Here “daily life” means “the ordinary things someone does each day”. The sentence says: He asks about my daily life, including lessons, meals and the journey home.
questions.parentExplanation: “daily life”在此处对应“日常生活”中的本句义项；句意为：他问起我的日常生活，包括课程、用餐和放学回家的路程。

translation.stem: 短文中的“daily life”是什么意思？

questions.stem: Why do the two classmates draw a school map?
questions.explanation: The answer is “To mark useful rooms and help Amir settle in.”. Evidence: I show him where we eat lunch and where our club meets. He tells me that he enjoys drawing maps of new places. Together, we sketch a simple school map with the most useful rooms marked. The map helps him settle in, and we begin sitting together at lunch.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“To mark useful rooms and help Amir settle in.”。原文依据：我带他看我们吃午饭的地方和社团集合的地方。他告诉我，他喜欢画新地方的地图。我们一起画了一张简单的校园地图，标出最常用的房间。地图帮助他适应新环境，我们也开始一起吃午饭。

translation.stem: 两位同学为什么画校园地图？

options.label: A
options.text: To plan a journey to another country.

options.label: B
options.text: To mark useful rooms and help Amir settle in.

options.label: C
options.text: To sell the school building.

options.label: D
options.text: To replace every lesson.

questions.stem: Which title fits best?
questions.explanation: The answer is “A School Map and a New Friendship”. Evidence: Our school pairs new students with classmates who can show them around. I make friends with a boy called Amir during this activity. He asks about my daily life, including lessons, meals and the journey home. I show him where we eat lunch and where our club meets. He tells me that he enjoys drawing maps of new places. Together, we sketch a simple school map with the most useful rooms marked. The map helps him settle in, and we begin sitting together at lunch.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“A School Map and a New Friendship”。原文依据：学校让新同学和能带他们熟悉校园的同学结伴。在活动中，我和一个叫阿米尔的男孩交上了朋友。他问起我的日常生活，包括课程、用餐和放学回家的路程。我带他看我们吃午饭的地方和社团集合的地方。他告诉我，他喜欢画新地方的地图。我们一起画了一张简单的校园地图，标出最常用的房间。地图帮助他适应新环境，我们也开始一起吃午饭。

questions.stem: What does “looks forward to” mean in this passage?
questions.explanation: Here “looks forward to” means “feels pleased and excited about a future event”. The sentence says: Mia looks forward to the planting morning because she loves being outdoors.
questions.parentExplanation: “looks forward to”在此处对应“期待；盼望”中的本句义项；句意为：米娅盼着种植活动的早晨，因为她喜欢户外活动。

translation.stem: 短文中的“looks forward to”是什么意思？

options.label: B

options.label: C

questions.stem: What does “take part in” mean in this passage?
questions.explanation: Here “take part in” means “join in an activity”. The sentence says: She asks three friends to take part in the work with her.
questions.parentExplanation: “take part in”在此处对应“参与”中的本句义项；句意为：她邀请三个朋友和她一起参与这项工作。

translation.stem: 短文中的“take part in”是什么意思？

questions.stem: Why does the group write labels?
questions.explanation: The answer is “So visitors can learn the plants' names.”. Evidence: They plant carefully and write labels so visitors can learn each plant's name.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“So visitors can learn the plants' names.”。原文依据：他们认真播种，写好标签，让参观者能知道每种植物的名字。

translation.stem: 小组为什么写标签？

options.label: A
options.text: So visitors can learn the plants' names.

options.label: B
options.text: So the seeds will need no water.

options.label: C
options.text: So nobody can find the garden.

options.label: D
options.text: So the friends can skip the work.

questions.stem: What is the main idea?
questions.explanation: The answer is “Mia and her friends join a school planting activity.”. Evidence: Our school garden needs help before the spring visitors arrive. Mia looks forward to the planting morning because she loves being outdoors. She asks three friends to take part in the work with her. The teacher gives each group a small patch of ground and some seeds. Mia's group reads the instructions before making spaces in the soil. They plant carefully and write labels so visitors can learn each plant's name. At the end, Mia is tired but pleased that her friends helped too.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“Mia and her friends join a school planting activity.”。原文依据：春季参观者到来前，学校花园需要大家帮忙。米娅盼着种植活动的早晨，因为她喜欢户外活动。她邀请三个朋友和她一起参与这项工作。老师给每组一小块地和一些种子。米娅的小组先读说明，再在土里挖出空位。他们认真播种，写好标签，让参观者能知道每种植物的名字。结束时，米娅虽然累，却很高兴朋友们也参与了帮忙。

translation.stem: 这篇短文的主旨是什么？

options.label: A
options.text: Visitors teach a class to cook seeds.

options.label: B
options.text: A child decides never to go outdoors.

options.label: C
options.text: Mia and her friends join a school planting activity.

options.label: D
options.text: A teacher removes all the garden labels.
